chunks: Muhammad ibn Ali Majiluyah (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Musa ibn Ja'far ibn Wahb al-Baghdadi, from Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah, from Musa ibn Ibrahim al-Marwazi, from Abu al-Hasan Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said: The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said:
In the sun there are four attributes: it changes the color, the breath becomes foul, it wears out the clothes, and it causes disease.
ai.seo_question: What are the four physical effects of the sun mentioned in this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Al-Khisal* highlights the tangible physical toll of solar exposure, linking environmental factors to health outcomes like complexion changes, halitosis, garment deterioration, and disease. It reflects the Shia scholarly tradition of integrating practical observation with spiritual teachings, emphasizing the body as an amanah (trust) that requires care against natural elements.
